cvScenarios.name: T09-01 concurrent authenticated reads initialize one empty version-1 scoped root
T09-09 same-scope foreign keys, English and snapshot constraints, forced RLS, default-deny roles and bounded indexes exist
T09-02 concurrent authenticated Owner POSTs replay one shared receipt after both miss the initial lookup
T09-03 and T09-05 accepted same-Owner PDF facts are snapshot-bound to a UUIDv7 English registered version
T09-06 registration increments the root and records one event without accepting or activating the CV
T09-07 exact replay preserves the original receipt; changed intent conflicts and a fresh stale root version fails

T09-04 unprocessed raw PDF, accepted non-PDF image, missing, foreign Owner, and non-English intents reject without writes: {"unprocessed":true,"wrongKind":true,"acceptedImage":true,"missing":true,"foreignOwner":true,"nonEnglish":true,"noWrites":true}
T09-08 Owner projections return deterministic latest-100 version and activation views without deleting retained rows
T09-06 root, version, receipt and event roll back together when outbox insertion fails

cvAcceptanceScenarios.name: T10-01 only the configured Owner can accept a same-Portfolio registered English PDF; missing and foreign versions disclose no private facts
T10-02 current accepted, safe, suitable and accessible Media facts retain the exact PDF object/hash/version under the shared Media lock
T10-04 approval, history, root increment, exact receipt and minimal event commit together while Current CV remains empty
T10-06 a new key cannot approve an already accepted CV version
T10-03 incomplete Media acceptance facts fail without changing CV approval state
T10-03 duplicate Media acceptance facts fail without changing CV approval state
T10-03 version-inconsistent Media acceptance facts fail without changing CV approval state
T10-04 injected history failure rolls back CV state, root version, approval and success receipt
T10-04 injected receipt failure rolls back CV state, root version, approval and success receipt
T10-04 injected outbox failure rolls back CV state, approval history, root version and success receipt
T10-06 a fresh stale shared-root If-Match fails without creating an approval
T10-03 a rejected Media asset changed after registration cannot be accepted from stale snapshot facts
T10-06 exact replay returns the original receipt before later root/Media checks; changed intent conflicts
T10-07 accepted CV snapshot and approval remain private history and never change the empty Current CV pointer
T10-08 strict response and Owner views expose no PDF content or Media snapshot; approval tables use scoped forced RLS and append-only access
T10-05 accepting another registered version leaves an existing Current CV pointer and its event history unchanged

mediaRejectionScenarios.name: Pending and accepted unused Media rejects; rejected state and history persist and future processing/acceptance fails.
Visible Content locale and Current CV use return MEDIA_IN_USE with no rejection mutation.
Hiding and archiving Content and activating a replacement Current CV remove the affected use.
Draft, Hidden, and Archived references allow rejection; publish, restore, and CV approval revalidate rejected Media.
Decision, version, receipt, and event commit atomically; injected failure rolls back and exact replay survives later version changes.
Independent publication, restore, CV acceptance, and activation races with rejection serialize to valid outcomes.
Accept/reject concurrency, changed-hash reuse, stale versions, and terminal transitions fail safely.
Current authoritative usage reads protect writes; retained objects stay private and capability expiry is documented.
Private rejection reason is absent from public event data and errors expose safe codes only.
